setupHint: Use the setup token from the KioskMate log once and create the first password.
signInHint: Sign in to manage this kiosk.
restartBrowserHint: Restarts the display browser and keeps the selected kiosk page active.
reloadBrowserHint: Reloads the active page in the existing browser session without clearing the Home Assistant login.
resetSessionHint: Backs up and clears Home Assistant browser data. You must sign in again afterwards.
liveViewHint: This is a backend-rendered snapshot of the active dashboard. Refresh it when you need a current picture.
liveViewStopped: The display browser is stopped. Start the display first; the preview is only a helper and can still be blocked by Home Assistant.
snapshotOnDemand: No screenshot has been requested yet. Refresh the snapshot to capture the real signed-in kiosk session.
recoveryWorkflowHint: Stops the browser, resets the HA session, restarts the display and checks reachability/rendering.
doctorHint: Checks display environment, browser binary, profile permissions, active page reachability and log tails.
browser-startHint: Starts the kiosk browser on the display.
browser-stopHint: Stops the kiosk browser process without stopping KioskMate.
browser-restartHint: Stops and starts the kiosk browser. Use this after browser setting changes or a stuck session.
browser-reloadHint: Reloads the active dashboard by restarting the browser on the same page.
browser-previousHint: Switches to the previous enabled kiosk page.
browser-nextHint: Switches to the next enabled kiosk page.
browser-reset-sessionHint: Deletes Home Assistant browser session data for the active page and restarts the display.
browser-repair-haHint: Resets the HA session and immediately checks whether the active page is reachable.
dashboard-page-checkHint: Runs a fast HTTP check against the active page.
dashboard-render-checkHint: Runs a headless render check to detect blank or white pages.
dashboard-preview-openHint: Opens the active dashboard in a normal browser tab.
dashboard-diagnosticsHint: Loads browser command, arguments, profile and watchdog diagnostics.
unsavedChangesHint: Save page changes before leaving this view.
repairHAHint: Resets the Home Assistant session, starts the display and checks page access for 403 errors.
watchdogKilledHint: The browser was killed by the watchdog. Check the watchdog reason and browser logs.
haForbiddenHint: HTTP 403 from Home Assistant. Clear the Kiosk IP from ip_bans.yaml and reset the HA browser session.
safeModeHint: Applies conservative browser settings for small Raspberry Pi devices and restarts the browser.
extraArgs: Extra browser args, one per line
themeSyncHint: Dark and light expose the matching OS color-scheme preference to the page after Save and restart. The selected Home Assistant or Material UI theme is preserved. Force dark additionally transforms pages and uses more CPU/GPU.
schedulerSaveHint: Changes apply on the next scheduler tick.
displayConnectingHint: Chromium is running while KioskMate connects page control and opens the configured page.
displayRunningHint: The kiosk session is running on
displayStoppedHint: The display browser is stopped. Start it to show the configured kiosk page.
displayStoppedErrorHint: The display stopped with the last error
openDashboardStatusHint: Open display controls and current status
openMQTTStatusHint: Open MQTT connection status and settings
temporaryOverrideHint: Show the selected page for a limited time, then return to the configured workflow.
last24Hours: Last 24 hours, persisted across service restarts
telemetryCollecting: Telemetry is being collected. The first point appears after one minute.
confirmProfileRecommendation: Apply the recommended performance profile and restart the display?
profileReasonLowMemory: Low-memory hardware benefits from one renderer and conservative graphics.
profileReasonPi4: Raspberry Pi 4 class hardware benefits from the low-power raster profile.
profileReasonPi5: Raspberry Pi 5 can use hardware acceleration with balanced process limits.
profileReasonHighMemory: Available memory supports Chromium's normal rendering quality.
openExternalHint: The page opens in a new browser tab because many dashboards block embedded previews.
mqttSaveHint: Test the connection before enabling MQTT permanently.
validationMQTTCertificatePair: Client certificate and key must be configured together.
validationMQTTMaximumPacket: Maximum packet size must be between 1 KiB and 256 MiB.
mqttLiveHint: Live protocol log. Each line is sent by the KioskMate backend while the test runs.
mqttTestPrompt: Check the broker URL and credentials, then run a live connection test.
mqttEnablePrompt: Enable MQTT and enter the broker details to publish Home Assistant entities.
mqttSaveToApply: Save the settings to start or restart the MQTT connection. Leave the password blank to keep the stored one.
mqttNoTestResult: No connection test has been run in this session. Use Test connection to see every protocol step live.
maintenanceReadyHint: Elevated access is available for package, service and repair jobs.
privilegeRequiredHint: Enter the sudo/root password and click Activate, or start a job — the password is verified and kept in memory for 15 minutes.
privilegeStorageHint: Enter the password and click Activate. It is verified with sudo/su and kept only in memory for 15 minutes.
powerActionsHint: These actions interrupt the kiosk immediately. Use them only when a restart or shutdown is intended.
confirmReboot: Restart the kiosk device now? The display and Admin UI will be unavailable temporarily.
confirmShutdown: Shut down the kiosk device now? It must be powered on locally afterwards.
noJobsYetHint: APT, service, repair and power jobs appear here with live output and their final exit status.
noLogsAvailable: No log entries match this source and filter.
adminEndpointHint: Address used by the KioskMate control panel
configPreviewHint: Review the affected areas before replacing the active configuration.
browserRestartAfterImportHint: Restart the kiosk display after applying so all browser changes take effect.
serviceRestartAfterImportHint: The Admin endpoint changed. Restart KioskMate after applying.
noChangelog: No changelog is available for this release.
automaticUpdateCheck: Automatically checked at startup and every 6 hours
enterPasswordBelow: Enter sudo or root credentials below
passwordMemoryOnlyHint: The password is never written to the configuration or disk. It is retained in process memory for up to 15 minutes only when selected.
updateReadyHint: The package is downloaded, verified and installed before KioskMate restarts automatically.
updatePrivilegeHint: Package installation requires passwordless sudo, a sudo password or the root password.
updateProgressHint: Download, verification, package installation and restart are shown here.
noUpdateJobs: No update has been started in this session.
dashboardUpdateHint: Review the changelog and install the signed package from the update page.
openUpdateHint: Open the update page and view the changelog
preflightResult_release_failed: KioskMate is already up to date
preflightResult_asset_failed: No matching Debian package was found
preflightResult_privilege_failed: Enter valid sudo or root credentials
updateHistoryHint: Installation results survive service restarts; configuration backups are created before package changes.
noUpdateHistory: No update history has been recorded yet.

pageWizardSaveReminder: Click Save (or Save & Start Kiosk) to apply this page change.

validationRuleName: Enter a name for this time rule.

validationScheduleEmpty: Add a rotation step or active time rule before enabling the scheduler.
validationBrokerUrl: Enter a valid mqtt://, mqtts://, ws:// or wss:// broker URL.
browserRestartHint: Restart the display to apply browser and rendering changes.
confirmRestart: Save config and restart the browser?
confirmResetSession: Reset the Home Assistant browser session?
confirmRestore: Restore this backup and reload the UI?
terminalHint: Commands run with the kiosk user and timeout after 60 seconds.
loginRetryAfter: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
loginSessionFailed: The server accepted the password but did not create a valid session.
requestTimeout: The kiosk did not respond in time.
backgroundLoadFailed: Some system data could not be loaded
adminLoadFailed: Admin UI could not be loaded
setupInfo: Run `kioskmate --admin-info` on the kiosk if you need the setup token again.
kioskSequenceHint: Arrange pages, timing and conditions in one workspace.
flowViewHint: Follow the path from START to the loop and edit any node.
storybookViewHint: Drag cards to define what appears next on the display.
scheduleNeedsEnable: A time schedule is configured but the scheduler is disabled. Enable it so the display follows 07:00–23:00.
schedulerNoActiveRuleHint: No time rule is active right now, so the scheduler has nothing to show. Add or adjust a time rule to cover this period.
schedulerDisabledWithRulesHint: Time rules are configured but the scheduler is disabled, so they are never applied. Enable the scheduler to use them.
addFirstPageHint: Create the first page to start a kiosk sequence.
activatePageHint: Show the selected page on the kiosk display now.
checkPageHint: Check whether the selected URL is reachable from KioskMate.
wizardHint: Only the settings needed for this page are shown.
urlValidationHint: The URL must start with http://, https:// or file://. Your existing browser session remains unchanged.
workflowReview: Page '{name}' runs for {timing}, then continues to '{next}'.
confirmRemovePage: Remove this page from the kiosk sequence?
pageSwitchTabs: Keep pages open as tabs (instant switch)
pageSwitchHint: Tabs keep recently shown pages loaded, so switching back needs no reload and no new Home Assistant login. Hidden tabs are throttled; each open tab costs memory.
pageSwitchIsolatedHint: Separate browser profiles per page are enabled: every page switch restarts the browser, and tab mode is not used.
scheduledReloadHint: A scheduled reload clears memory that long-running dashboards accumulate. It keeps the session and is much cheaper than a watchdog browser restart.
authMonitorHint: Login failures happen while a page loads. Monitoring only then saves CPU on the kiosk; a lost session reloads the login page, which re-arms monitoring.
workflowsHint: Rules that react to an MQTT message, a time of day or a webhook and run actions on top of the page sequence.
noWorkflows: No workflows yet. Example: when the doorbell rings, show the camera page for 30 seconds.
webhookHint: Call it with POST. Anyone who knows this URL can run the workflow.
conditionsHint: Optional. The workflow only runs when all of these hold.
onlyWhenPage: Only while this page is shown
testWorkflowHint: Run the actions now and ignore trigger and conditions.
workflowTestSaveFirst: Save first: a test runs the saved version.
workflowSaveReminder: Click Save to activate the workflow change.
validationWorkflowTopic: Enter an MQTT topic without + or # wildcards.
validationWorkflowTime: Enter the time the workflow should run.
validationWorkflowWindow: A time window needs both start and end.
validationWorkflowActions: Add at least one complete action.
idleTriggerHint: Runs once after this time without touch, click or key input; the next input re-arms it.
touchTriggerHint: Runs on touch, click, key or scroll input on the kiosk page. Use a cooldown to limit how often.
untilResume: Until a "Back to the sequence" action
validationIdleSeconds: Idle time must be between 10 and 86400 seconds.
validationSoundUrl: The sound needs an http(s) URL or nothing.
preloadPageHint: Opened as a tab when the browser starts and never closed, so switching to it is instant. Costs memory.
preloadPageNeedsTabs: Only takes effect with page switching set to tabs (Kiosk -> Display and rendering).
conflict_time_rules_overlap: The time rules {a} and {b} overlap; the first one wins.
conflict_rules_same_trigger: The workflows {a} and {b} react to the same event and both run.
conflict_rule_page_topic: The workflow {a} and the page {b} listen on the same MQTT topic.
isolatePageSessionsHint: Only needed when pages sign in as different Home Assistant users: every page switch then restarts the browser.
watchdogRebootOnHang: Reboot when the page stays frozen
watchdogRebootOnHangHint: A frozen page is reloaded first, then the browser restarts. Only when restarts stop helping (6 per hour) is the system rebooted. Needs reboot rights under Privileges.
localPageHint: KioskMate renders this page itself and serves it to the kiosk browser on this device. No internet connection or extra server is needed.
slideshowFolderHint: Absolute path on this device, e.g. a USB stick or network share. JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and AVIF are shown; new images appear after one pass. Images close to the screen resolution save memory on a Raspberry Pi.
localHtmlHint: Runs in a sandbox: scripts work, but the page cannot use cookies, local storage or the Admin API. Maximum 256 KB.
validationSlideshowFolder: Enter the absolute path of the image folder.
validationSlideshowInterval: Seconds per image must be between 2 and 86400.
validationLocalHtml: Enter the HTML for this page.
validationLocalHtmlSize: The HTML must be at most 256 KB.
noTouchDeviceHint: no touch device detected. Check the USB cable and the power supply.
undervoltageHint: The power supply is too weak. The board throttles its CPU and can drop USB devices such as touch controllers. Use a 5.1 V / 3 A supply with a short cable.
insertOnly: Only as an insert or on demand
navOverviewHint: What is on screen now and what comes next
navProgramHint: Which page runs when, with inserts in between
automationsLead: Automations react to events such as an MQTT message from the doorbell, a time of day, a webhook or a touch. Afterwards the programme takes over again.
showNowHint: Shows the page for one hour, then the programme takes over again.
upNextEmpty: No inserts planned. The base programme keeps running.
todayWindowsHint: Time windows of the base programme, the line is now
todayRotationHint: The base programme rotates all day
checkBrowserLoadHint: The browser uses a lot of CPU. Tab mode with preloaded pages or reloading the page often helps.
checkAuthGuardHint: Home Assistant rejected the login. Run “Repair Home Assistant session” under Overview → Troubleshooting.
checkMQTTHint: Check address, user and password under Automations → MQTT connection.
checkHotHint: The processor is hot and will throttle soon. Add cooling or a case with a fan.
checkMemoryHint: Memory is almost full. Preload fewer pages or reload the page.
checkDiskHint: Storage is almost full. Clean up old logs and packages.
checkTimeHint: Without the correct time, windows and inserts run at the wrong moment. Check the NTP server below.
baseProgrammeHint: These pages take turns or run in fixed time windows. Drag to reorder.
insertsHint: Pages that briefly come in between on a fixed rhythm
noInsertsHint: For example the cameras every 5 minutes or today's calendar at the full hour.
nextHourHint: The base programme is on screen {percent} % of the time
priorityHint: Top to bottom: the higher one wins
priorityStep1Hint: “Show now”, temporary display and automations such as the doorbell.
priorityStep2Hint: If two are due at once the higher priority wins, with equal priority the upper one.
priorityStep3Hint: Pages with fixed times. Outside them the screen turns off if set so. Inserts do not wake it.
priorityStep4Hint: The remaining pages take turns by their duration.
insertDialogHint: The insert briefly interrupts the base programme, which then carries on.
insertOnlyToggle: Show the page only as an insert, not in the base programme
insertPreloadHint: Stays loaded in the background and appears instantly.
insertPreloadNeedsTabs: Only works in tab mode (Device → Display). Otherwise the page reloads for every insert.
validationInsertDuration: The duration must be shorter than the interval.
addNewPageHint: Choose when it runs in the programme afterwards
newClockHint: Rendered by the kiosk, works offline
baseEmpty: Nothing in the base programme yet
baseEmptyHint: Add a page that runs all the time or in a time window.
baseExplainer: Time window pages run at their times; the first match wins. Outside them the rotation pages take turns, or the display turns off. Drag or use the arrows to reorder.
flowHint: The base programme runs {percent} % of the time, the rest is inserts
mqttOffForAutomations: Time, webhook, touch and idle automations work without MQTT too.
showNowSaveFirst: This page is not saved yet. Save first, then show it.
snapshotAutoHint: A new picture every 30 seconds while the overview is open
todayHint: Today's base programme and inserts; the line is now
tplDoorbellHint: A doorbell MQTT message wakes the display and shows a page for 60 s
tplMorningHint: On at 07:00 and back to the programme
tplIdleHint: Back to the programme 5 minutes after the last touch
tplTouchHint: A touch turns the display on
tplWebhookHint: Calling a secret URL shows a page for 60 s, e.g. from Home Assistant
workflowTemplatesHint: Opens the editor filled in; you only adjust it
pageEnabledHint: Active; switching off removes the page from the flow
pageDisabledHint: Disabled; switch on to use the page again
templateEvery5Hint: E.g. 30 seconds of weather or cameras
templateTimesHint: E.g. at 8, 12 and 18 o'clock for 2 minutes
msgBrowserExitedClean: The browser quit by itself after {1}
msgRecoveryExhausted: Automatic recovery gave up; please restart manually
msgMemoryLimit: Memory {1} MB above the {2} MB limit
msgMissingXServer: No X server: set the display backend to Wayland under Device › Display
configChangedTitle: The configuration changed in the meantime
configChangedHint: Since you opened this page, the configuration was saved elsewhere, for example in another browser, by Home Assistant or by an automation. Reload discards your changes here; Overwrite replaces the other change.
configChangedKept: Not saved. The current configuration is loaded now.
sunTimesHint: Start and end can also be sunrise or sunset, with an offset in minutes.
sunTimesNeedLocation: Start and end can also be sunrise or sunset. For correct times, enter the location under Programme > Advanced (otherwise 06:00 and 18:00 are used).
insertConditionToggle: Only show while a condition holds
insertConditionHint: The insert only runs while the last MQTT message on the topic has the value, for example a motion sensor reporting "ON". Home Assistant states reach MQTT through MQTT Statestream or an automation.
insertConditionNeedsMQTT: Conditions read MQTT topics. Set up MQTT first (Automations > MQTT), otherwise the insert never shows.
conditionNotMetNow: Condition does not hold right now
validationConditionTopic: Enter an MQTT topic without # or +.
validationConditionValue: Enter the value at which the insert should run.
presenceHint: A motion sensor can switch the display on when someone is in front of it and off again after a while without motion.
presenceModeWake: Switch on outside the scheduled times when someone is there
presenceModeRequire: Only switch on when someone is there
presenceTimeout: Stay on after the last motion
presenceTouch: Touching the screen counts as presence
presenceSources: Other sources: the "Presence Detected" button in Home Assistant, the topic …/presence/set and POST /api/presence.
presenceSourcesNoMQTT: Without MQTT, touches or POST /api/presence (for example from a Home Assistant automation) report presence.
presenceNow: Someone is there, display stays on until {time}
locationHint: Only needed for sunrise and sunset. Two decimals are enough.
locationUnavailable: The browser does not share its location (often only over HTTPS). Please enter the values from a map.
videoDecode_ok: Hardware video decoding is available and there is enough video memory.
videoDecode_pi5: The Raspberry Pi 5 has no H.264 hardware decoder (only HEVC). The CPU always decodes H.264 camera streams. A smaller camera substream or HEVC helps.
videoDecode_cma_failures: The kernel failed {count} times to reserve video memory (cma_alloc). The hardware decoder starves, Chromium decodes in software and uses a lot of CPU. Fix: in {file} set dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d,cma-512, remove gpu_mem and reboot.
videoDecode_cma_small: Only {mb} MB contiguous video memory (CMA). Too little for camera streams and large screens: set dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d,cma-512 in {file} and reboot.
videoDecode_gpu_mem: gpu_mem={gpu} reserves memory for the old firmware graphics stack that the KMS driver does not use. Remove gpu_mem from {file} and size video memory with dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d,cma-512 instead.
videoDecode_software: Chromium reports no H.264 hardware decoder, so the CPU decodes video. Check that the Raspberry Pi OS Chromium package is used and that /dev/video10 (bcm2835-codec) exists.
videoDecode_no_decoder: No V4L2 video decoder found. Without it Chromium decodes video in software.
setupStepScreen: When should the screen be on?
setupPageHint: The first page, usually your Home Assistant dashboard. Add more pages, rotation and inserts in the programme afterwards.
setupPageHaTip: Tip: for Home Assistant, create a separate user and a dashboard without sidebar, for example …/lovelace/kiosk.
setupScreenHint: Outside these times KioskMate switches the screen off if the device supports it.
setupMqttHint: With MQTT the kiosk appears in Home Assistant as a device with switches and sensors, and automations can react to motion sensors.
setupSummaryNoMqtt: Without MQTT (you can set it up later)
setupSummaryHint: Everything can be changed later. The assistant is available again under Device > Configuration.
setupDoneHint: The kiosk starts with your page.
validationMqttUrl: The broker URL must start with mqtt:// or mqtts://.
doctor_display_env_error: The kiosk service has no display session (neither DISPLAY nor WAYLAND_DISPLAY is set). KioskMate must run inside the kiosk user's graphical session.
doctor_display_power_wayland_ok: A tool to switch the screen on and off under Wayland is installed.
doctor_display_power_wayland_warn: No tool to switch the screen on and off under Wayland was found. Please install wlopm (or wlr-randr).
doctor_runtime_dir_warn: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is empty, so the service often cannot reach the graphical session.
doctor_runtime_dir_error: The runtime directory (XDG_RUNTIME_DIR) is not accessible.
doctor_browser_command_error: The browser program was not found. Install Chromium or choose a valid program in the settings.
doctor_browser_profile_error: The browser profile cannot be created or written. Check the profile folder's permissions.
doctor_browser_running_error: The browser stopped with an error. The technical details and the browser log show why.
doctor_active_page_ok: The active page is reachable from the kiosk.
doctor_active_page_error: The active page is not reachable from the kiosk. Check the address, the network and, for Home Assistant, ip_bans.yaml.
doctor_touch_input_ok: A touch input device is registered.
doctor_touch_input_warn: No touch input device is registered with the kernel. If the screen should react to touch, check the USB cable and the power supply.
doctor_power_supply_warn: There was undervoltage since boot. Use a 5.1 V / 3 A supply with a short cable; weak supplies throttle the CPU and can disconnect USB touch controllers.
doctor_power_supply_error: Undervoltage right now: the power supply is too weak. The Pi throttles and USB devices such as touch controllers can drop out.
doctor_gpu_warn: Chromium renders without graphics acceleration. That costs a lot of CPU on small devices; try GPU mode "hardware".
doctor_extra_args_warn: --disable-dev-shm-usage moves Chromium's shared memory to the SD card. Remove it from the extra arguments unless KioskMate runs in a container.
reasonPresence: On outside the scheduled times because someone is there
